configurePresets.name: vs-x64
configurePresets.description: VST2+CLAP, x64 (NanoVG/GL2, GUI/GDI editor on by default). SDKs via SMU2000_* cache vars / env.

configurePresets.name: vs-win32
configurePresets.description: VST2+CLAP, Win32 (NanoVG/GL2, GUI/GDI editor on by default). SDKs via SMU2000_* cache vars / env.

configurePresets.name: ci-win64
configurePresets.description: CI: SDK dirs from env (VST2_SDK_DIR), no ROM staging.

configurePresets.name: ci-win32
configurePresets.description: CI: SDK dirs from env (VST2_SDK_DIR), no ROM staging.

configurePresets.name: vs-x64-tools
configurePresets.description: vs-x64 plus the native render/live/gui exes (native/CMakeLists.txt; imgui/D3D allowed there). Own binaryDir _bld/vs-x64-tools. Artifacts add build-cmake/tools/x64/<Config>/*.exe.

configurePresets.name: vs-win32-tools
configurePresets.description: vs-win32 plus the native render/live/gui exes (JIT32 default-ON per CPU32_LEDGER.md). Own binaryDir _bld/vs-win32-tools. Artifacts add build-cmake/tools/Win32/<Config>/*.exe.

configurePresets.name: mingw-x64
configurePresets.description: MSYS2 MINGW64 shell required. Ninja + gcc. Graphics-free default; JIT on (x86_64). Artifacts in build-cmake/<api>/x64-mingw/Release/. SDKs via SMU2000_* cache vars / env.

configurePresets.name: mingw-clang-x64
configurePresets.description: MSYS2 MINGW64 shell required (clang from mingw-w64-x86_64 toolchain). Ninja + clang. Artifacts in build-cmake/<api>/x64-mingw-clang/Release/.

configurePresets.name: mingw-win32
configurePresets.description: MSYS2 MINGW32 shell required (mingw-w64-i686 toolchain). Ninja + gcc. JIT compiled-in since 2026-09-16 (dual-mode JITs; see CPU32_LEDGER.md). CI builds this via build-native.yml (build-mingw matrix); verified working on the dev box with MSYS2 gcc 16.1 Rev5. Artifacts in build-cmake/<api>/Win32-mingw/Release/.

configurePresets.name: mingw-ci-x64
configurePresets.description: CI: SDK dirs from env (VST2_SDK_DIR), no ROM staging. MSYS2 MINGW64 shell.

configurePresets.name: mingw-ci-win32
configurePresets.description: CI: SDK dirs from env (VST2_SDK_DIR), no ROM staging. MSYS2 MINGW32 shell.
